participants.title: Participants
participants.intro: Participants are shown by a masked email or phone number only.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.deleteConfirm: Delete this session and its task results?
sessions.orderReadOnly: Order {{order}} (set by the study, cannot be changed)

live.title: Live session
live.body: Follows which step the participant is on, updated every few seconds. No answers or results are shown.
live.alert: Tier {{tier}} at {{time}}. Follow the session safety script and check in with the participant.
live.notYet: Nothing yet. Steps appear here once the participant signs in on their phone.

phone.title: Study phone
phone.body: Link a study phone to this session with a QR code. When the session ends, the phone is cleared automatically.
phone.scan: Open the phone's camera and point it at this code, then tap the link that appears.
phone.qrAlt: QR code to set up the study phone
phone.wiping: Waiting for the phone to clear itself…
phone.endAndWipeConfirm: End this session? The linked study phone sends anything still waiting, then clears everything and signs out within about 15 seconds.

safety.title: Safety events
safety.intro: Records hold the tier, trigger and actions only, never answers or scores.

tiers.3: Tier 3: plan or intent, or cannot keep safe

users.title: Users
users.search: Search by name, email or phone
users.name: Name
users.deleteConfirm: Delete this account and all its data? This cannot be undone.

content.title: Content
content.intro: Every version needs approval from two different people before it is published.
content.yourDraft: You wrote this draft, so someone else must review it.

deletions.title: Deletion requests
deletions.intro: Complete each request within 72 hours. Completing removes the participant's data and contact details.
deletions.completeConfirm: Delete this participant's check-ups, profile and contact details now? This cannot be undone.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.intro: Every staff action, in order. Entries can never be changed.

flags.title: Features
flags.intro: Turn optional features on or off for this environment. Every change is recorded.

names.guideGenerative: Rinda guide (AI rewording, needs ethics amendment)

research.title: Research report
research.privacy: Everything here is counted across all participants. No names, contacts, answers or IDs are included.
research.tasksBody: {{sessions}} sessions, {{ended}} finished. The bar shows how many completed each task, with or without help.
research.othersBody: {{withCheckup}} participants did at least one check-up. {{wellness}} answered the mood and stress questions ({{wellnessConsent}} agreed to them).
research.bandsBody: Each participant's latest check-up. Counts only.

collect.title: Collect without internet
collect.intro: When a phone has no internet, open Results on the phone and tap 'Hand over to the facilitator'. Point this laptop's camera at the phone until every part is received.
collect.locked: Packages are locked. This laptop cannot read them; only the Rinda server can open them.
collect.noCamera: The camera is not available. Check that this browser is allowed to use it.
collect.received: Package received. You can scan the next phone.
collect.offline: No internet yet. Packages stay on this laptop and can be uploaded later.
collect.result: Uploaded: {{saved}} new, {{already}} already received, {{invalid}} could not be used.
collect.undelivered: Scanned {{date}}: the server could not accept this package. The phone still has its own copy and will send it when it is online.
collect.discardConfirm: Remove this package from this laptop? The phone keeps its own copy and sends it when it is online.
collect.uploadedToast: Done: the hand-over is uploaded ({{saved}} new). It now shows on the dashboard.

qrSessions.title: QR code sessions
qrSessions.intro: Every offline check-up handed over by QR code and uploaded by a facilitator, newest first.
qrSessions.empty: No check-ups have been received by QR code yet.
qrSessions.loadFailed: The list could not be loaded. Please try again.
